scope: DuckDB UUID values and logical result metadata in mixed and zero-row queries
before_fix: The new assertions failed: populated mixed projections and zero-row UUID projections both exposed Utf8 ColumnInfo metadata instead of UUID.
contract: A UUID logical-type column decodes to Value::Uuid when other columns precede and follow it.
UUID-shaped VARCHAR remains Value::Text in the same result rows.
Typed UUID NULL remains Value::Null across multiple rows.
Mixed result metadata reports UUID for typed UUID columns and preserves Utf8 for VARCHAR controls.
A zero-row UUID projection still reports its alias and UUID result type.

focused_contract.command: rtk cargo test --offline --locked -p tablepro-driver-duckdb --test integration uuid_ -- --test-threads=1
